description.value: Ironworks Café & Crêperie is a locally-owned café established in 2018 by Dina Stuehler, specializing in Belgian-style crepes made from scratch alongside freshly roasted Italian coffee. The Duncan location on Station Street is part of a small Vancouver Island chain with a warm, community-focused atmosphere and a menu that ranges from savoury lunch crepes to indulgent sweet options. It is a well-regarded stop in downtown Duncan, drawing regulars and visitors alike with its inclusive menu and welcoming ethos.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Duncan location at 64 Station Street and shows active operations with recent Instagram posts and seasonal features. The menu explicitly offers Gluten-Free Buckwheat Batter and Whole Wheat Vegan Batter with vegan substitution notes, confirming dietary options. No bike infrastructure, washroom details, Wi-Fi, or water refill are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name spells 'Crepperie' (double p, no accent); website uses 'Crêperie' — stored as OSM value per rules.
Phone number (1.855.748.9371) appears on website footer but is absent from OSM; contact_confirmed.phone set to null as there is no OSM value to corroborate.
News page references Ladysmith and Chemainus locations; current website home page lists only Duncan and Nanaimo as active locations — Ladysmith/Chemainus may be closed or seasonal.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating café with confirmed address and recent web activity; a useful food and drink stop for touring cyclists in downtown Duncan.
enrichment_extras.notes: Catering service is available with advance notice, which could be useful for organised cycling groups or events.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'Gluten-Free & Vegan options'; menu lists Gluten-Free Buckwheat Batter and Whole Wheat Vegan Batter; most sweet crepes are marked as vegan-substitutable and gluten-free adaptable. Note: kitchen cannot safely accommodate celiac disease due to cross-contamination risk
